outline.rationale: The user is a total beginner aiming to run product interviews soon, so the outline is built end-to-end around the interview lifecycle and excludes surveys, usability testing, analytics, and academic theory per the confirmed scope. Node 1 grounds them in what interviews are good for (replacing a generic "basics" node with something interview-specific). Nodes 2–5 follow the natural prep-to-execution sequence: recruiting, guide-writing, non-leading questioning (explicitly called out in the understanding), and live facilitation. Node 6 addresses the classic beginner trap of taking stated preferences at face value. Nodes 7–8 cover synthesis and acting on findings, closing the loop toward product decisions. Siblings are largely non-overlapping: recruiting vs. questioning vs. analysis are distinct skills with little content bleed. Kept to 8 nodes to stay practical and avoid spreading thin.
